name: Bug clinic
description: Issue -> reproduce -> diagnose -> fix -> regression test. Produces reproduction evidence and a verified fix.

steps.title: Reproduce: {{issue}}
steps.acceptance: Failure reproduced with an exact command or steps and captured output.
steps.instructions: Reproduce {{issue}}. Record the exact command, environment, and observed vs expected output. If you cannot reproduce, say so.

steps.title: Diagnose root cause of {{issue}}
steps.deliverable: Root cause note with file/line references
steps.acceptance: Root cause points to specific code and explains the mechanism.
steps.instructions: Find the root cause of {{issue}} using the reproduction. Cite files and lines.

steps.title: Fix {{issue}}
steps.acceptance: Fix addresses the diagnosed cause; diff is minimal.
steps.instructions: Implement the smallest fix for the diagnosed cause of {{issue}}.

steps.title: Regression test for {{issue}}
steps.deliverable: Test that fails before and passes after the fix
steps.acceptance: Test output shows failure on the old code and success on the fix.
steps.instructions: Add a regression test for {{issue}}. Run it and record the output.
